summary: Post-merge bug fixes surfaced by the user's full test run. Two bugs were missed by both spec-reviewer and code-reviewer because the failing tests only reproduce when running the full suite (the format-string error is reached late in pipeline init, and the config key assertion is on a key the reviewers didn't enumerate).

bugs_fixed.issue: Orphan cv_workers=%d placeholder in logger.info format string. The implementer removed the cv_workers argument (along with PHASE2_CV_FOLD_WORKERS) but left the placeholder in the format string. Result: every test that calls log_gpu_runtime_config() failed with TypeError: not enough arguments for format string. This was the root cause of 23 test failures across test_phase2_rule_pool.py, test_crash_fix_and_run_logging.py, and test_phase2_rule_pool_properties.py.
bugs_fixed.fix: Removed the 'cv_workers=%d' placeholder from the format string and the trailing ' ' before it. No args removed; just the unused placeholder.

bugs_fixed.issue: PHASE2_REQUIRE_LAST_FOLD_POSITIVE config key was removed but the check it gated (in _passes_pool_admission_impl, gated on cv_fold=False so it ran in the holdout path) is a legitimate holdout-mode deployability filter. tests/unit/test_config_additions.py::test_new_config_parameters_exist asserts the key exists.
bugs_fixed.fix: Restored PHASE2_REQUIRE_LAST_FOLD_POSITIVE = False (default) in config.py with an updated docstring explaining it now only runs in the holdout path. Restored the check in phase2_support.py before the val_trade floor check.

verification.broader_test_unit_passes: 898 passed (excluding slow test_phase2_rule_pool.py which was tested separately: 93/93)

lesson_learned: Future spec-reviewer/code-reviewer checks should: (1) explicitly run the failing test classes mentioned by the user, not just the imports and grep checks; (2) include a smoke test that calls log_gpu_runtime_config() or any logger call whose format string was edited; (3) enumerate every config key the tests reference (not just the ones in the diff).
